Name: More Silo Storage
Author: OrneryWalrus
Description:
[u]Requirements[/u]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.2[/b] & [b]SMAPI 2.xx[/b]

[u]Installation[/u]
Extract the contents of the MoreSiloStorage.zip file to your StardewValley/Mods folder.

[u]What Does It Do?[/u]
This mod increases your farms total Silo storage to 240,000. You must have at least 1 Silo on your farm, however any additional Silos beyond 1 serve no purpose with this mod installed.

[u]How Does It Do That?[/u]
This mod uses a Harmony transpiler to replace the StardewValley.Utility.numSilos method at run-time.
Tested and confirmed working on SDV 1.2.33 & SMAPI 2.5.5.

[u]Why Did You Make This?[/u]
This mod was created because the only silo storage increasing mod available currently only works in the beta version.


Please post if you have any issues with this mod and I will do my best to address.

Manifest.Name: MoreSiloStorage
Manifest.Description: Expands the capacity of the Silo
